front.title: Verifiable Legal Entity Identifier (vLEI) CDDL Schema

section.name: Conventions and Definitions
section.t: The key words "MUST", "MUST NOT", "REQUIRED", "SHALL", "SHALL NOT", "SHOULD", "SHOULD NOT", "RECOMMENDED", "NOT RECOMMENDED", "MAY", and "OPTIONAL" in this document are to be interpreted as described in BCP 14 when, and only when, they appear in all capitals, as shown here.

section.name: CDDL Schema
section.t: The CDDL fragments below collectively define the vLEI credential schemas. The root fragment defines the top-level credential choice; the remaining fragments define credential-specific properties and the shared identifiers, node references, and disclaimer types used by those credentials.

section.name: vLEI Credential Types
section.t: The top-level vLEI defines the supported vLEI credential types.

section.name: Legal Entity vLEI Credential
section.t: The Legal Entity credential defines issuer, subject, edge, and rule blocks.

section.name: Top-level Credential Definition
section.sourcecode:
; Legal Entity vLEI Credential
lei-cred = [ lei-boilerplate, lei-properties ]

section.name: Credential Properties
section.sourcecode:
; ============================================================ ; LEI Properties Block ; ============================================================ ; Top-level properties for Legal Entity vLEI Credential
lei-properties = { ; structural attributes v: tstr, ; Version d: said, ; Credential SAID u: tstr, ; One time use high entropy nonce i: aid, ; Credential Issuer - a QVI entity ri: tstr, ; Credential status registry s: said, ; SAID of this lei schema ; subject attributes a: lei-a, ; edge properties e: lei-e, ; rule properties r: lei-r }

section.name: Credential Boilerplate
section.sourcecode:
; ============================================================ ; LEI Boilerplate ; ============================================================ ; Legal Entity vLEI Credential boilerplate metadata
lei-boilerplate = { ? "$id": "ENPXp1vQzRF6JwIuS-mp2U8Uf1MoADoP_GqQ62VsDZWY", ? "$schema": "http://json-schema.org/draft-07/schema#", ? title: "Legal Entity vLEI Credential", ? description: "A vLEI Credential issued by a Qualified vLEI issuer to a Legal Entity", ? type: "object", ? credentialType: "LegalEntityvLEICredential", ? version: "1.0.0" }

section.name: Qualified vLEI Issuer Credential
section.t: The Qualified vLEI Issuer credential defines attributes and disclaimers for the issuer qualification credential.

section.name: Top-level Credential Definition
section.sourcecode:
; Qualified vLEI Issuer Credential
qvi-cred = [ qvi-boilerplate, qvi-properties ]

section.name: Credential Properties
section.sourcecode:
; ============================================================ ; QVI Properties Block ; ============================================================ ; Top-level properties for QVI vLEI Credential
qvi-properties = { v: tstr ; Version d: said ; Credential SAID u: tstr ; One time use high entropy nonce i: aid ; GLEIF Issuee AID ri: tstr ; Credential status registry s: said ; Schema SAID a: qvi-a, r: qvi-r }

section.name: Credential Boilerplate
section.sourcecode:
; ============================================================ ; QVI Boilerplate ; ============================================================ ; Qualified vLEI Issuer Credential boilerplate
qvi-boilerplate = { ? "$id": "EBfdlu8R27Fbx-ehrqwImnK-8Cm79sqbAQ4MmvEAYqao", ? "$schema": "http://json-schema.org/draft-07/schema#", ? title: "Qualified vLEI Issuer Credential", ? description: "A vLEI Credential issued by GLEIF to Qualified vLEI Issuers which allows the Qualified vLEI Issuers to issue, verify and revoke Legal Entity vLEI Credentials and Legal Entity Official Organizational Role vLEI Credentials", ? type: "object", ? credentialType: "QualifiedvLEIIssuervLEICredential", ? version: "1.0.0" }

section.name: Official Organizational Role vLEI Credential
section.t: The Official Organizational Role credential defines role attributes and either authorization or Legal Entity credential edges.

section.name: Top-level Credential Definition

section.name: Credential Boilerplate

section.name: OOR Authorization Credential
section.t: The Official Organizational Role authorization credential defines the requested recipient, role, Legal Entity edge, and disclaimer blocks.

section.name: Top-level Credential Definition
section.sourcecode:

oor-auth-cred = [ oor-auth-boilerplate, oor-auth-properties ]

section.name: Credential Properties

oor-auth-properties = { v: tstr ; Version d: said ; Credential SAID u: tstr ; Single use high entropy nonce i: aid ; LE Issuer AID ri: tstr ; Credential status registry s: said ; Schema SAID a: oor-auth-a, e: oor-auth-e, r: oor-auth-r }

section.name: iXBRL Data Value Attestation
section.t: The iXBRL Data Value Attestation credential provides attestation of data values extracted from iXBRL reports, linked to either a vLEI OOR or vLEI ECR credential.

section.name: Top-level Credential Definition
section.sourcecode:
; iXBRL Data Value Attestation
ixbri-cred = [ ixbri-boilerplate, ixbri-properties ]

section.name: Credential Properties
section.sourcecode:
; ============================================================ ; iXBRL Properties Block ; ============================================================ ; Top-level properties for iXBRL Data Value Attestation
ixbri-properties = { v: tstr ; Version d: said ; SAID of this credential i: aid ; AID of the issuer ri: tstr ; Credential status registry s: said ; Schema SAID a: ixbri-a e: ixbri-e }

section.name: Credential Boilerplate
section.sourcecode:
; ============================================================ ; iXBRL Boilerplate ; ============================================================ ; iXBRL Data Value Attestation boilerplate
ixbri-boilerplate = { ? "$id": "EMhvwOlyEJ9kN4PrwCpr9Jsv7TxPhiYveZ0oP3lJzdEi", ? "$schema": "http://json-schema.org/draft-07/schema#", ? title: "iXBRL Data Value Attestation", ? description: "A data attestation against an iXBRL report, linked to either a vLEI OOR or vLEI ECR credential", ? type: "object", ? credentialType: "iXBRLDataAttestation" }

section.name: Shared Types and Disclaimers
section.t: The shared fragment defines identifier types, node and schema references, and canonical disclaimer text. The SAID type is imported from the IETF SAID specification.

section.name: SAID Type
section.t: The SAID (Self-Addressed Identifier Digest) type is imported from the IETF SAID specification and supports multiple representation profiles.
section.sourcecode:
; The shared type is extended by the supported representation profiles. said = $said $said /= said-cbor $said /= said-json $said /= said-cesr $said /= said-urn ; The URN representation is a CESR digest prefixed with "urn:cesr:said:". ; The URN payload is the CESR text defined by said-cesr. said-urn = $said-urn $said-urn /= "urn:cesr:said:" .cat said-cesr ; CBOR can carry a CESR representation or an algorithm/digest tuple. said-cbor = $said-cbor $said-cbor /= said-cesr $said-cbor /= said-alg-digest
; hash-alg-id is from the IANA Named Information Hash Algorithm Registry. said-alg-digest = [ hash-alg-id: int hash-value: bstr ] ; JSON can carry CESR text or an algorithm/digest object. said-json = $said-json $said-json /= said-cesr $said-json /= said-json-alg-digest
; JSON uses a hash-algorithm name and an unpadded base64url digest. said-json-alg-digest = { hash-alg-id: tstr hash-value: tstr .regexp "[A-Za-z0-9_-]+" } ; CESR text is a digest-algorithm code followed by encoded digest text. said-cesr = $said-cesr $said-cesr /= said-cesr-256 $said-cesr /= said-cesr-512
said-cesr-256 = $said-cesr-256 $said-cesr-256 /= "E" .cat said-cesr-256-text ; Blake3-256 $said-cesr-256 /= "F" .cat said-cesr-256-text ; Blake2b-256 $said-cesr-256 /= "G" .cat said-cesr-256-text ; Blake2s-256 $said-cesr-256 /= "H" .cat said-cesr-256-text ; SHA3-256 $said-cesr-256 /= "I" .cat said-cesr-256-text ; SHA2-256 said-cesr-256-text = (tstr .size 43) .regexp "[A-Za-z0-9_-]+"
said-cesr-512 = $said-cesr-512 $said-cesr-512 /= "0D" .cat said-cesr-512-text ; Blake3-512 $said-cesr-512 /= "0E" .cat said-cesr-512-text ; Blake2b-512 $said-cesr-512 /= "0F" .cat said-cesr-512-text ; SHA3-512 $said-cesr-512 /= "0G" .cat said-cesr-512-text ; SHA2-512 said-cesr-512-text = (tstr .size 86) .regexp "[A-Za-z0-9_-]+"

section.name: Core Primitives
section.t: Core data type primitives including identifiers, maps, and date-time values used across all vLEI credentials.

section.name: Node-Schema Pairs
section.t: Schema node pairs for linking credentials to their schemas, with both generic and credential-specific variants.

section.name: Node-Schema Triples
section.t: Schema node triples for OOR and ECR authorization credentials, including operator constraints.

section.name: Disclaimer Text Constants
section.t: Canonical literal text for disclaimers including usage, issuance, and privacy considerations.
section.sourcecode:
; ============================================================ ; Disclaimer Texts ; ============================================================ ; Canonical legal disclaimer text for vLEI credentials
; canonical literals for each disclaimer usage-disclaimer-text = "Usage of a valid, unexpired, and non-revoked vLEI Credential, as defined in the associated Ecosystem Governance Framework, does not assert that the Legal Entity is trustworthy, honest, reputable in its business dealings, safe to do business with, or compliant with vlei-any laws or that an implied or expressly intended purpose will be fulfilled."
issuance-disclaimer-text = "All information in a valid, unexpired, and non-revoked vLEI Credential, as defined in the associated Ecosystem Governance Framework, is accurate as of the date the validation process was complete. The vLEI Credential has been issued to the legal entity or person named in the vLEI Credential as the subject; and the qualified vLEI Issuer exercised reasonable care to perform the validation process set forth in the vLEI Ecosystem Governance Framework."
privacy-disclaimer-text = "Privacy Considerations are applicable to QVI ECR AUTH vLEI Credentials. It is the sole responsibility of QVIs as Issuees of QVI ECR AUTH vLEI Credentials to present these Credentials in a privacy-preserving manner using the mechanisms provided in the Issuance and Presentation Exchange (IPEX) protocol specification and the Authentic Chained Data Container (ACDC) specification. https://github.com/WebOfTrust/IETF-IPEX and https://github.com/trustoverip/tswg-acdc-specification."

section.name: Disclaimer Objects
section.t: Concrete disclaimer object definitions that reference the canonical text constants.

front.title: Key words for use in RFCs to Indicate Requirement Levels

abstract.t: In many standards track documents several words are used to signify the requirements in the specification. These words are often capitalized. This document defines these words as they should be interpreted in IETF documents. This document specifies an Internet Best Current Practices for the Internet Community, and requests discussion and suggestions for improvements.

front.title: Ambiguity of Uppercase vs Lowercase in RFC 2119 Key Words

abstract.t: RFC 2119 specifies common key words that may be used in protocol specifications. This document aims to reduce the ambiguity by clarifying that only UPPERCASE usage of the key words have the defined special meanings.
